source: Quackles process/OVERNIGHT-2026-10-16.md, the operator log of one overnight run (2026-10-16, times CDT). Transcribed row by row; wording condensed, outcomes as the log states them. Source-reported: no review was re-run for this study.
protocol: Each candidate is rendered as a copy of the current scene and shown to two fresh blind reviewers (Opus 5.5 subagents) as a LOOK pair and a CLEAR pair, with the sides swapped between reviewers so neither knows which image is the candidate. A candidate becomes the agent pick only if both reviewers prefer it; a split, a tie or a narrow loss holds it. The owner has not approved any pick.
